WEBSITE INFORMATION

Your privacy.

Last updated: 23 September 2026.

About this website

This website presents Grandison Plumbing & Heating, operated by Connor Grandison in Fife, Scotland.

Enquiry information

The enquiry form is not connected to a delivery service. It does not submit or store information entered into it. Do not use it to send an enquiry.

External services

Links to MyBuilder and other websites take you to services with their own privacy notices. Those services control the information you share with them.

Hosting and fonts

The hosting provider may process technical request information to deliver and protect the website. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts, which receives technical connection information, such as your IP address, when your browser requests them.

Analytics and advertising

This version does not include analytics or advertising trackers. It does not create marketing profiles or mailing-list subscriptions.

Contact

For privacy questions, use the contact options on the Grandison Facebook page relating to the business. This notice will be updated when direct enquiry handling is enabled.
